name: Token-level foreground/background contrastive supervision on frozen SAM2 memory values
status: Frozen for seq2/seq3 engineering gate and conditional efficacy screen
research_scope: Exploratory PolypGen study. This cohort informed previous analyses, and sequence-level independence from patients is unverified.

prior_work.adaptation_boundary: Reuse MAVOS's gated depthwise focal levels and global-context modulation equations only. Do not claim to reproduce MAVOS, its dynamic memory, its DeAOT training, or its benchmark scores.

contrastive_source.reuse: Use the pinned author SupConLoss unchanged; no new contrastive loss implementation.

hypothesis: A focal residual on actual spatial memory value tokens, trained with a soft foreground-versus-background contrastive objective in addition to autoregressive segmentation loss, may improve SAM2 video masks over both native SAM2 and an identical segmentation-only value adapter.
design_amendment: This is a new, direct value-token test of the previously discussed segmentation-only versus segmentation-plus-contrastive comparison. Earlier contrastive experiments acted on different readers/projections and are not counted as evidence for this memory-value hypothesis.

method.insertion: The trainable module acts on the actual spatial memory value-token vectors immediately before the frozen native v_proj in each of SAM2 memory attention’s four layers. The contrastive objective is computed on these adapted value vectors before v_proj; it does not replace or add attention weights.
method.operation: For each concatenated 64x64 spatial frame block independently, apply MAVOS’s context projection; sequentially apply its gated depthwise focal convolutions with kernels 3 and 5; pool global context from the final focal representation; and project the aggregate as a residual added to the original token feature. Initialize the final projection to zero for native identity before training. The integration follows SAM2 MemoryAttention.batch_first: transpose native [batch,tokens,channels] values into the adapter’s token-first grid view and transpose back before v_proj. If a read contains only object-pointer tokens and no spatial frame, pass it through unchanged.
unchanged: all spatial memory tokens and frames
memory writes, image encoder, and mask decoder
method.trainable: Only four focal residual modules; SAM2 remains frozen and in evaluation mode.
method.region_labels: None. This tests token-context modulation, not predicted foreground/background/boundary categories.
method.frames_and_tokens: No frame selection, token deletion, thresholding, or confidence gating. The spatial sequence is parsed as complete 4096-token frame blocks followed by SAM2's pointer-token tail; malformed layouts fail closed.

contrastive_supervision.features: Per-frame foreground and background prototypes area-pooled from the actual adapted spatial memory value vectors consumed by the native attention read.
contrastive_supervision.labels: Fractional occupancy from that stored frame’s ground-truth mask, pooled to the token grid; foreground and background weights are complementary, so mixed cells contribute to both prototypes.
contrastive_supervision.objective: Pinned upstream SupContrast SupConLoss, temperature 0.07, auxiliary coefficient 0.1; same-role prototypes from different stored frames are positives and opposite-role prototypes are negatives. If fewer than two prototypes for either role are present, the auxiliary term is exactly zero for that read.
contrastive_supervision.data_boundary: Ground truth is read only after the normal forward/read and only to construct the auxiliary training loss. It is never fed to the predictor, memory writer, or inference path. Memory values remain generated by the model’s own predicted masks.
contrastive_supervision.scope: This directly tests region-level token representation/utilisation at the memory-value input. It does not test semantic purity of individual vectors or attention-token selection.

conditions.C0: Native pretrained SAM2; all pretrained parameters, memory writes/reads, pointers, positional encodings, and decoder unchanged.
conditions.C1: Four MAVOS-style focal residual value adapters, trained with the ordinary autoregressive mask and object-presence losses only; contrastive coefficient exactly 0.
conditions.C2: Identical four adapters, initialization, optimizer, chronological training frames, optimizer updates, mask/presence losses, validation, and evaluation as C1; add the frozen soft foreground/background SupCon term with coefficient 0.1.

excluded_sequences.seq1: No positive prompt frame under the existing protocol.
excluded_sequences.seq7: No positive prompt frame under the existing protocol.

data.prompt: First labeled frame; score only post-prompt frames.
data.unit: Sequence. Patient-to-sequence mapping is not verified; do not claim patient-independent inference.
data.test_status: All PolypGen data informed earlier analyses; this remains exploratory, not held-out confirmation.

training.device: CPU FP32; do not change device within an attempt.
training.trainable_initialization: C1 and C2 use the same seed and identical initialization; each is initialized from scratch, not from previous runs.
training.schedule: One chronological autoregressive pass through every post-prompt frame in the ten frozen training sequences; 1,035 targets and 263 optimizer updates per arm; chunk size and truncated BPTT are four frames. Reinitialize SAM2 prompt and memory at each sequence boundary. Report one pass as a pilot, not convergence.
training.loss: Existing autoregressive present-frame mask BCE/Dice-style and object-presence losses. C2 adds the specified four-layer mean SupCon term, weighted 0.1. All targets are loss-only after prediction.
training.checkpointing: Atomic adapter, optimizer, RNG, schedule cursor, memory bank, per-clip receipt and source/protocol hashes after each four-frame update; resume must verify hashes and exact next-update replay.

must_pass_before_training_or_efficacy: Synthetic tests: exact identity at zero residual, finite nonzero adapter gradients, unchanged pointer tail, valid frame-block reshape, and fixed permutation/inverse round-trip.
Real-frame seq2 and seq3 gate: zero-initialized C1 and C2 reproduce native SAM2 masks and stored-memory receipts bit-for-bit on every frame.
Verify actual per-frame spatial memory alignment and native spatial plus temporal positional encodings; ensure pointer values and positional encodings remain byte-identical.
Verify all four memory cross-attention layers execute and each receives finite nonzero adapter gradients, while no pretrained SAM2 parameter gets a gradient or changes hash.
Verify a trained one-update adapter changes propagation output, produces finite masks, and safely saves/resumes to the exact next-step output.
Verify persistent multi-object IDs on a real multi-object VOS clip before making a multi-object support claim; PolypGen alone cannot establish this.
Honor SAM2 batch_first layout, including the initial pointer-only read; pointer-only inputs must pass through bit-identically.

evaluation.validation_selection: Choose the earliest checkpoint maximizing equal-sequence present-frame Dice on seq13–15; validation is run after the completed one-pass training schedule (one checkpoint), so no epoch cherry-picking.
evaluation.release_rule: Proceed to the PolypGen test sequences only if C2 exceeds both C0 and C1 by at least 0.01 equal-sequence present Dice on seq13–15, wins at least 2/3 sequences against each, and increases equal-sequence GT-empty false-alarm rate by no more than 0.02 absolute against C0. Otherwise stop. This is a screening rule, not evidence of statistical significance.
evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice; report C2−C0 and C2−C1.
evaluation.native_baseline_reuse: Reuse existing native per-frame receipts only after checkpoint, config, prompt, frame coverage, and prediction hashes match this setup. Otherwise regenerate native once before the adapter efficacy run.
evaluation.external_confirmation: If the PolypGen screen passes, evaluate on an available, licensed DAVIS multi-object split using its official metric implementation and persistent object IDs. Previously inspected DAVIS sequences are exploratory. Do not report SA-V without authorized data access.

provenance.launch_status: Seq2/seq3 engineering gate passed before this final protocol freeze; rerun that gate against the committed protocol/source hashes. Efficacy is not started until the matched code and protocol commit exists.
